verdict.rationale: Zero documents its own MCP server (MCP.md) whose tools cover the whole loop: reading threads and folders, searching, triage (read/unread, labels, archive), and creating, sending, and sending drafts of email. An external agent could therefore in principle work the inbox end to end. However, the connection is only a prose capability list with no endpoint schema, authenticated by pasting a browser session cookie, with OAuth still 'coming soon'. missing for 10: proper auth (OAuth) for external agents, endpoint/tool schema documentation, a docs site, hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent completing the loop, explicit Claude/ChatGPT connection guides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails

Mark emails as read/unread
- Modify email labels
You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
Copy the session cookie from your browser cookies and place it into the Authorization header.
